from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
import numpy as np

r = Robot()
s = r.spec()
limits = np.asarray(s['qpos']['range'], dtype=float)
origins = np.asarray(s['proprio']['position_m'], dtype=float)
axes = np.asarray(s['proprio']['axis'], dtype=float)
left_hand = np.asarray(s['links']['com_m'][16], dtype=float)
feet = s['links']['feet']

def command(p):
    return np.clip(2 * (p - limits[:, 0]) / (limits[:, 1] - limits[:, 0]) - 1, -1, 1).tolist()

def body_rotation(obs):
    g = np.asarray(obs['imu']['gravity'])
    return Rot.from_euler('yx', [np.arctan2(g[0], -g[2]), -np.arcsin(g[1])]).as_matrix()

def point(q, chain, v):
    t = np.eye(4)
    for i in chain:
        rot = Rot.from_rotvec(axes[i] * q[i]).as_matrix()
        joint = np.eye(4)
        joint[:3, :3] = rot
        joint[:3, 3] = origins[i] - rot @ origins[i]
        t = t @ joint
    return (t @ np.r_[v, 1.0])[:3]

def foot_points(q, w, side):
    box = feet[side + '_ankle_link']
    corners = np.array([[x, y, z] for x in (box[0][0], box[1][0])
                        for y in (box[0][1], box[1][1])
                        for z in (box[0][2], box[1][2])])
    chain = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] if side == 'left' else [5, 6, 7, 8, 9]
    return np.array([w @ point(q, chain, c) for c in corners])

obs = r.reset(images=False)
initial_q = np.asarray(obs['proprio']['joint_pos'])
initial_w = body_rotation(obs)
initial_feet = [foot_points(initial_q, initial_w, side).mean(axis=0)
                for side in ('left', 'right')]
base = initial_q.copy()
base[[2, 7]] = -.6
base[[3, 8]] = .5
base[[4, 9]] = -.4
base[11:15] = [-1., 0., .2, 0.]
obs = r.step('qpos', [command(base)] * 60, images=False)
print('approach', obs['step'], obs['done'], np.round(obs['imu']['gravity'], 2), flush=True)

def pelvis_pose(obs):
    q = np.asarray(obs['proprio']['joint_pos'])
    w = body_rotation(obs)
    now = [foot_points(q, w, side) for side in ('left', 'right')]
    xy = np.mean([initial_feet[i][:2] - now[i].mean(axis=0)[:2] for i in range(2)], axis=0)
    z = -np.mean([f[:, 2].min() for f in now])
    return np.r_[xy, z], w

def reach(target, n, label):
    global obs
    for j in range(0, n, 5):
        if obs['done']:
            break
        q = np.asarray(obs['proprio']['joint_pos'])
        pelvis, w = pelvis_pose(obs)
        desired = np.asarray(target) - pelvis
        def residual(arm):
            test = q.copy()
            test[11:15] = arm
            return w @ point(test, [10, 11, 12, 13, 14], left_hand) - desired
        result = least_squares(residual, q[11:15],
            bounds=([limits[i, 0] for i in range(11, 15)],
                    [limits[i, 1] for i in range(11, 15)]), max_nfev=50)
        p = base.copy()
        p[11:15] = np.clip(result.x + .35 * (result.x - q[11:15]),
                            limits[11:15, 0], limits[11:15, 1])
        obs = r.step('qpos', [command(p)] * min(5, n-j), images=False)
    pelvis, w = pelvis_pose(obs)
    q = np.asarray(obs['proprio']['joint_pos'])
    hand = pelvis + w @ point(q, [10, 11, 12, 13, 14], left_hand)
    print(label, obs['step'], 'pelvis', np.round(pelvis, 2), 'hand', np.round(hand, 2),
          'q', np.round(q[11:15], 2), 'done', obs['done'], obs['reason'], flush=True)
    if not obs['done']:
        image = r.observe(images=['room_camera'])['images']['room_camera']
        Image.fromarray(image).save('/app/output/gen_' + label + '.png')
    return not obs['done']

for x in (.82, .9, .98):
